$description: The AI digital board demonstrations (apps/web/src/islands/board.ts). The board is drawn in its own units, width by height, and scaled to fit. durationMs: how long each demonstration plays before the next. pauseAfterPickMs: how long a picked demonstration stays before the cycle resumes. type: text sizes in board units. grid: the spacing of the board's squared lines. Colours and fonts come from the surface roles and type tokens.
